title: Black Range Museum

services.name: Walking Tour
services.desc: Two prospectors, Dave Stitzel and Daniel Dugan, discovered gold on the east side of the Black Range Mountains along Percha Creek in April 1877. The discovery led to a rapid influx of miners, store owners, and many others, creating a tent city that grew quickly. Hillsboro became the county seat of Sierra County in 1884 and remained so until 1936, when Hot Springs (now Truth or Consequences) took that position.
